items.title: Elon Musk is pouring money into the midterms. Here's where he's giving the most.
items.summary: Elon Musk is giving reams of cash to Republicans, and most of it's going to Ken Paxton in Texas.

items.title: Jeff Bezos says ‘millions of people’ will be living in space by 2045—and robots will commute on our behalf to the moon
items.summary: No one enjoys the dreaded commute to work, and by 2045, Amazon founder Jeff Bezos predicts we’ll have robots to do that for us. After all, in his vision we’ll be venturing to other planets for our 9-to-5's.
items.titleZh: 杰夫·贝佐斯说，到2045年，“数百万人”将生活在太空中，机器人将代表我们前往月球
items.summaryZh: 没有人喜欢可怕的通勤，到2045年，亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯预测，我们将有机器人为我们完成这项任务。毕竟，在他的愿景中，我们将在朝九晚五的时间里冒险前往其他星球。

items.title: J Mascis has nothing better to do
items.summary: Dinosaur Jr. frontman J Mascis is known as something of a slacker guitar god. He stands stoically onstage, barely moving, as he seemingly effortlessly works through deft guitar solos and lopsided riffs. Unfortunately, Mascis has developed a similar reputation…
